regime_context: The China A-shares tape is a narrow, one-narrative regime: only Banks and Coal clear the absolute-trend eligibility gate (2 of 22 themes), with Banks showing extreme crowding (z=1.85, breadth 1.0, one_narrative=true) and Coal a more modest profile. Critically, the backtest verdict says the trend gate did NOT reduce drawdown on this market historically (gate_helps=false), so the eligibility filter itself has little validated value here — treat every lean as low-conviction by default, and note the track record's directional accuracy is just 0.337.
emerging_watch: Watching whether the narrow two-theme regime (Banks + Coal, frac=0.09) shows a CONFIRMED handoff to a broader base — specifically, whether Industrial Metals (rank 4, 512400.SS, currently ineligible) becomes eligible on the trend gate while Coal's durability_bar breaks below ~0.3. No handoff is confirmed until that gate flips; nothing to act on yet.

theses.subject: Banks
theses.thesis: Banks are the sole leader with full breadth (1.0), a strong durability_bar (0.83, the only 'trend' Hurst tag among top ranks), and clear eligibility. The overweight is a continuation lean on the prevailing narrative's persistence, not a forecast — the detector only flags where leadership and flow are concentrating, not that it will keep rising.
evidence: crowding_z=1.85, crowded=true (size-down caution only, not a fade)
theses.dissent: Mean-reverting tape per backtest — the gate did NOT hold on this market, so eligibility itself may be a false signal, and crowding at z=1.85 suggests the Banks move is mature and vulnerable to a sharp shake-out.

falsifier.text: 512800.SS prints a new 20-day low while the CSI 300 is flat or up over the same window

theses.subject: Coal
theses.thesis: Coal is the only other eligible name, rank 2 with score 1.038 and durability_bar 0.55. It is the rotation challenger (rotation.challenger=cn_coal), but the margin over Banks is tiny (0.04) and directionality is flagged false. Lean is a modest relative-continuation read on the second-eligible theme, not a call that Coal overtakes Banks.
evidence: durability_bar 0.55, hurst_tag 'mean-revert' (weaker trend health than Banks)
theses.dissent: Coal's Hurst tag is 'mean-revert' not 'trend', and breadth is only 0.5 — it is a thinner leadership than Banks, and the mean-reverting regime documented in the backtest bodes poorly for continuation.

falsifier.text: 515220.SS lags the CSI 300 by more than 3% over the next 15 trading days

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
